question: does the fixed context floor measured on probes hold on real episodes
design: one burned pilot task (T1-context-artifact) run once in the minimal condition and once in the full condition, structured output mode, same pinned backend

falsifier_outcome.falsifier: if the fixed floor varies materially across episodes of the same backend, treating it as a constant is wrong
falsifier_outcome.diagnosis: the probes ran in an empty directory, so the floor they measured was the harness context alone; a real episode also carries its mounted workspace, and the full condition mounts an evidence pack of 145,906 bytes

attribution_limit: the two episodes differ in both factors at once and each condition was run once, so nothing here attributes cost to retrieval or to the scaffold separately, and no effect is claimed
